name: Arcfin Sync
description: Keeps each user's Arcfin settings in step across their devices and keeps a record of those devices. Administrators set defaults and locks per setting, for everyone or for one user, from the Jellyfin dashboard. Also extracts single audio tracks for Arcfin downloads and reports which video encoders the server's hardware can use.
overview: Syncs Arcfin app settings across a user's devices, with admin defaults and locks.

versions.changelog: Pick Together: people on the server swipe through titles on iPhone and iPad until they agree on one, then watch it on one device, on another, or together over SyncPlay. They join with a code or a QR code in Arcfin; every call needs a sign-in. Each person only gets titles everyone in the session can see and, unless watched titles are included, that nobody has watched; a title is never dealt twice in a session. The device that starts a session hosts it: it deals new titles, removes people and locks the session, and several devices on one shared profile each take part. Administrators turn it on or off for everyone or for chosen users on a new Pick Together tab and from Arcfin.

Settings catalogue: the plugin carries Arcfin's list of settings and serves it at GET /ArcfinSync/Schema, and only settings in it are stored. GET/PUT /ArcfinSync/Sync: each value with where it comes from, which device changed the settings last, and Replace to send one device's settings to the user's others. A record of each user's Arcfin devices, which users and administrators can rename and forget. Server-wide and per-user defaults and locks for administrators. One configuration page with Overview, Settings and Users & Devices tabs. Removed the notification, Seerr webhook and advanced YAML options, which nothing used. GET/PUT Settings keep their shapes, and 0.3 locks and defaults stay written so going back to 0.3.1 keeps them.

Added GET /ArcfinSync/Items/{itemId}/Audio/{streamIndex}: copies one audio track out with the server's ffmpeg as AAC in an .m4a, so Arcfin can keep several audio tracks in a converted download (Jellyfin's conversion keeps only one). Client Settings: Download Quality now offers Arcfin's four download choices.

Added GET /ArcfinSync/Encoders: which video encoders (H.264, HEVC, AV1) work with the server's hardware acceleration setting, from a one-frame test encode per codec with the server's own ffmpeg and device. Kept until the encoding settings change; ?refresh=true tests again. Arcfin uses it to ask for AV1 only where the card can encode it.

Fixed the plugin targeting the wrong Jellyfin ABI (was 10.9.0.0/net8.0, now 12.1.0.0/net10.0), which caused a Malfunctioned status on real servers. Removed an unnecessary FrameworkReference the plugin loader rejects. Replaced the free-form Locked Settings table with a real Client Settings editor mirroring the app's own Settings hierarchy. seerrUsername is now derived from Seerr Account Type's lock state instead of being independently lockable. Switched dashboard tab navigation to Jellyfin's real multi-page mechanism.
